Class IncrementalResultStore

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.tools.io.internal.IncrementalResultStore
public final class IncrementalResultStore extends Object
Incremental per-test pass store with a validity-stamped merge (#7335).

record(Path, Path, long, Function) copies every passed Allure result of the current run (with its attachments and the fixture containers that reference it) to <store>/<journey>/<testId>/ plus a manifest.json holding the IncrementalResultStore.ValidityKey. A failure never overwrites a stored pass; it is appended to failures.jsonl next to it. merge(Path, Path, Function) rebuilds one results folder from the stored passes, rejecting entries whose files-hash, app hash or SHAFT version differ from the current key (stale) and passes that have a newer failure on the same files-hash (flagged).

    • record

      public static int record(Path resultsDir, Path journeyDir, long runStartMs, Function<String, IncrementalResultStore.ValidityKey> keyForClass) throws IOException
      Records the current run's results into the store.
      Parameters:
      resultsDir - Allure results folder of the run
      journeyDir - <store>/<journey> folder
      runStartMs - run start; results that started earlier are leftovers and are ignored
      keyForClass - validity key for a test class (fully qualified name, may be empty)
      Returns:
      number of passes stored
      Throws:
      IOException - when the store cannot be written
